== Notes ==
* Though pets move 25% faster than players, it is not counted against them when being given a movement speed bonus, effectively increasing them to be moving 66.2% faster than players
* The attack speed boost can help to land time sensitive pet attacks ([[Disrupting Lunge]] or [[Bestial Pounce]], for example).
